expectation: The stars will pass through the returning galaxy's outskirts, with their paths affected by its gravity.

reaction: It was satisfying to see the contrast between stars and gas brought back at the crossing.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the lane-born stars through the crossing was worthwhile because it showed how becoming stars changed the material's response to another galactic encounter.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no notably repetitive or confusing passage in this one-decision chapter.

surprise.text: The result clarified that the stars' paths change while they pass among one another, rather than crushing together like their parent clouds.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; the destination followed directly from the chapter's setup.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how these different stellar populations settle into the shared galaxy, though this chapter offered only one decision.
